executive_assessment.text: One model estimates over 4.2 million people, including 538,000 in N’Djamena, face at least 10 cm inundation in a 100-year flood.
Rural vulnerability is tied to rain-fed farming and less durable homes; recent urban arrivals often settle in low-lying areas with weak drainage.
